summary: Phase 2 of the fleet map rework: replace the map's left rail (three flat, kind-grouped site lists plus an "Appliances to assign" list with a per-node building-selector dropdown, which never showed a camera) with a two-tree digital twin (map/twin_tree.js). "Everywhere" nests place > area > camera - kind shown as a glyph on the row rather than a group heading, the owning recorder shown beside each camera as a dim tag rather than a parent (a single mymatasan node's cameras can live in different places), a placement with no camera (the site's own map pin) rendered as a leaf tagged "the appliance", and a point asset's single implicit area hidden as a level so its cameras hang straight off the place. The root row carries a "{placed} / {total} placed" counter (a trailing + when an appliance is unreachable, since the total is then a lower bound). "Not placed yet" is the tray and the only branch where a node is a parent - it lists each node's cameras holding no pin plus any node whose own box pin is missing, and an unreachable node reports "cameras unknown", never "0 unplaced", so an operator is never told the job is finished when it isn't. One search box filters both trees and keeps ancestors of a match; the tree indents with logical CSS properties so it nests from the right in Arabic. Expanding a place now fetches its areas with their placements in one call (GET /api/sites/{id}/floorplans) instead of floors plus a per-area round-trip, and the per-node camera fetch over the tunnel now covers every adopted node (not only nodes at already-placed sites) so an unplaced node's cameras still surface in the tray. Also adds eslint.undef.config.mjs and an `npm run lint:undef` script - a single-rule (no-undef) ESLint config that catches an identifier webpack will happily compile but that throws a runtime ReferenceError; running it while making this change surfaced and fixed four such identifiers left over from the prior file-split commit (markerShape in fleet_map.js; useCallback, nodeKindOf, nodeToneKey in map/popups.js), each hidden behind a condition no bench had reached.
compatibility: Backward compatible for existing installs - no schema, API, or config changes. Existing node-to-site assignments (ManagedNode.SiteId) keep colouring their place exactly as before. One functional gap results from removing the old rail's per-node dropdown: there is currently no UI action that writes ManagedNode.SiteId (PUT /api/nodes/{id}/building still exists and works, just unreached from any screen); a later phase reintroduces this as the node's own box pin, meant to become the sole writer of SiteId. 19 new tree.* i18n keys added and 6 orphaned keys (map.assets, map.nodesToPlace, map.assignHint, map.showFloors, bld.kindPlural.building/outdoor/point) removed across en/ms/zh/ar.
